## Accordion
```html
<div class="rp-accordion rp-accordion-expanded">
  <button type="button" class="rp-accordion-summary" aria-expanded="true"><span class="rp-accordion-title">Applied filters</span></button>
  <div class="rp-accordion-details">…</div>
</div>
```
- shared.js toggles `rp-accordion-expanded` and `aria-expanded`.
- `rp-accordion-secondary` has no shadow (inside a tile); `rp-accordion-show-dividers` stacks rows with lines.

## Divider
```html
<hr class="rp-divider" />
<span class="rp-divider rp-divider-vertical"></span>
```
Tables never have vertical dividers: columns are separated by spacing.
